name_zh: 能源转型/德国/核退出/可再生/储能/氢能/工业脱碳
description_zh: 德国能源转型 (Energiewende) 2000年可再生能源法 (EEG) 启动，2011福岛后加速核电退出 (2023年最后三座关闭)，可再生能源占电力比超 50%，储能/氢能/电网数字化支撑间歇性电源，工业脱碳推动钢铁/化工/水泥绿色转型，目标 2045 碳中和。
description_en: German Energiewende launched 2000 Renewable Energy Act (EEG), 2011 Fukushima accelerated nuclear phase-out (2023 last three closed), renewables exceed 50% electricity share, storage/hydrogen/grid digitalization support intermittent sources, industrial decarbonization drives steel/chemicals/cement green transition, target 2045 carbon neutrality.
reason_zh: 德国能源转型代表工业强国如何通过政策设计实现能源系统根本性重构，展示了核电退出如何与可再生能源扩张协同而非对立，其储能/氢能/电网三位一体模式为全球能源转型提供了系统性范式。
reason_en: German Energiewende represents how industrial power achieves fundamental energy system restructuring through policy design, demonstrating how nuclear phase-out synergizes with renewables expansion not opposition, its storage-hydrogen-grid trinity model providing systemic paradigm for global energy transition.
steps_zh: 研究2000年EEG上网电价/可再生能源补贴机制
分析2011福岛后核电退出立法/八座立即关闭/2023完成
探讨可再生能源从 7% 到 50%+ 的扩张路径与电网挑战
评估储能/氢能/电网数字化/需侧响应/工业脱碳协同
总结核退出/可再生主导/储能氢能/工业脱碳/能源联邦五重遗产
steps_en: Study 2000 EEG feed-in tariff/renewable subsidy mechanism
Analyze 2011 Fukushima nuclear phase-out law/eight immediate closures/2023 completion
Explore renewables from 7% to 50%+ expansion path and grid challenges
Evaluate storage/hydrogen/grid digitalization/demand response/industrial decarbonization synergy
Summarize nuclear phase-out/renewables dominance/storage hydrogen/industrial decarbonization/energy federation quintuple legacy
expected_zh: 掌握核电退出如何与可再生能源扩张形成政策合力，理解储能/氢能/电网三位一体如何解决间歇性难题，评估德国能源联邦模式对欧盟/全球能源转型的系统性示范。
expected_en: Master how nuclear phase-out synergizes with renewables expansion as policy force, grasp storage-hydrogen-grid trinity solving intermittency, evaluate German energy federation model systemic demonstration for EU/global energy transition.
case_zh: 2000 EEG；2011 核退出加速；2023 核电归零；2045 碳中和。核退出/可再生/储能氢能/工业脱碳/能源联邦范式永存。
case_en: 2000 EEG; 2011 nuclear phase-out accelerated; 2023 nuclear zero; 2045 carbon neutral. Nuclear phase-out/renewables/storage hydrogen/industrial decarbonization/energy federation paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: German Environmental Policy / Energy Transition / Industrial Ecology
cross_cultural_impact: Nuclear phase-out; renewables; hydrogen; storage; grid; industrial decarbonization
scientific_contribution: 是: 能源系统/氢能/储能
environmental_stewardship: 是: 碳中和/可再生能源/核退出
conflict_resolution_mechanism: 立法/市场机制/技术标准
